title: Training
subtitle: Step-by-step guides and explainer videos for every area of SECRET 58 — always available here for reference.

welcomeBanner.title: Welcome to SECRET 58!
welcomeBanner.body: Thanks for your purchase. Before you dive in, take a quick look at "First steps" below — so the AI agents work with your real data from the start.

firstSteps.title: First steps
firstSteps.description: Do these three things first, then every AI agent works with real data instead of placeholders.
steps: Under "Settings → Own access keys", enter your own AI key from Anthropic, OpenAI or Gemini. The AI features use only your own key; the AI provider bills you directly. Without your own key, the app works in template mode with fixed text blocks.
Under "Brand DNA", fill in your own brand (tone, audience, values) — every AI agent uses this for the text it generates.
Under "Ideas & Inspiration" or "Content Brain", generate your first idea or campaign.

contentBrainToFactory.title: Content Brain → Content Factory
contentBrainToFactory.description: How an idea becomes finished, approved content.
steps: In Content Brain, create a new campaign with a topic and target platforms — this automatically produces several content items.
In the Content Factory, each content item moves through a status: Draft → In review → Approved → Scheduled → Published.
Approval is a manual, required step — nothing is published automatically without confirmation.
In a content item's detail view, you can regenerate script, voiceover, subtitles, hashtags, and thumbnail individually.

studios.title: Script, Voice, Video & Design Studio
studios.description: The specialized tools for every content building block.
steps: Script Studio: generates scripts following the Hook → Problem → Value → Example → Payoff → CTA structure.
Voice Studio: import or create your own ElevenLabs voice, then generate a voiceover directly from a script.
Design Studio: the thumbnail agent suggests a title, visual idea, text, layout, and image description.
Video Studio: shows the current state of the video provider connection (format manager, provider status).

calendarPublishing.title: Content calendar & publishing
calendarPublishing.description: Where scheduled posts show up — and why a post actually goes out (or doesn't).
steps: The content calendar lists every content item with a scheduled publish date.
Before every publish, the PublishingAgent checks live whether the target platform is actually marked "Connected" under "Social Media".
Without a real platform connection, it honestly shows an error instead of faking a successful publish.

analyticsGrowth.title: Analytics & Growth
analyticsGrowth.description: Real numbers on your own performance — and recommendations instead of automation.
steps: Analytics only shows stored statistics (e.g. sample data). Platform statistics are not fetched automatically yet; you enter numbers by hand under "Referrals" or in the variant comparison – they are evaluated there.
The Growth page calculates best posting times, top hashtags, and best-performing formats from that data.
Important: there is deliberately no automated follower/engagement growth (no bot behavior) — that would violate every platform's terms of service.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: AI-drafted replies to messages — with approval before sending.
steps: Messages from platforms are not fetched yet and replies are not sent. To try it out, you create conversations as a simulation.
The MessageAgent drafts a reply based on Brand DNA and conversation history.
You review and approve the draft. Sending to platforms is not built yet – "Approve & send" honestly reports this as an error instead of faking success.

revenue.title: Revenue tracking
revenue.description: One overview of all platform revenue — payout still runs through the platforms themselves.
steps: Revenue is logged manually, since TikTok/Meta offer no public revenue API and YouTube requires Partner Program access (not yet connected).
The actual payout always runs directly through the respective platform (e.g. YouTube via Google AdSense) — SECRET 58 never processes payouts.

integrations.title: Integrations & API keys
integrations.description: Where every connection status comes from, and where to set the matching key.
steps: Every row shows the real, live-checked status — never a faked connection.
You enter your own access keys (AI keys, Resend for the newsletter) under "Settings → Own access keys" – a guide there leads to the provider's official key page.

Credentials are never stored in the browser, only encrypted on the server. Voice output and the platforms' app credentials are set up by the operator; "Not available yet" means the connection has not been built in the app yet.

Costs: Pro and Maxi are subscriptions, monthly or yearly. Current prices are under "Plan & billing". For your own access keys (AI, Resend), each provider bills you directly under its own pricing model – SECRET 58 never charges extra for this.
